SubmitAnswer.description:
A participant's answer to the pending question.

Exactly one of ``text`` (free speech or typing, extracted into structured evidence) and
``outcome`` (a structured tap answer) must be given. ``participant_id`` must match the
participant the question was addressed to; it is never inferred from the text.

post.description: Ask a human approver for a consequential action the decision calls for.
The approved executor collects the single-use capability (expires in 5 minutes).

Needs the approver role. The approval records the signed-in approver; a free-text
``approver_id`` is used only when sign-in is not enforced (tests).

Mint the participant's join token (operator only). It works at the simulator and, for
that participant's own answers and actions, at the core.

get.description:
The pending question, spoken in the participant's language (WAV).

Cached audio is one WAV. Otherwise the WAV is streamed while Timbre synthesises it
(``X-Audio-Streamed: true``; its header has an open-ended data length, as Timbre's own
WAVs do), so the browser can start playing before synthesis finishes.
Rebuild the investigation from its event log and compare with the recorded belief.

Push the investigation's events: backfill after ``after_seq`` (or the browser's
``Last-Event-ID``, whichever is later), then follow new events live.

200.description: Server-Sent Events. Each log event has `id: <seq>` and `data: <EventEnvelope>`. Control events: `ready`, `reset`, `bye`. Comments `: ping` are heartbeats.
